title: Lateral support.
officialText:
Floor, attic and roof framing with a nominal depth-to-thickness ratio greater than or
equal to 5:1 shall have one edge held in line for the entire span. Where the nominal depth-to-thickness ratio of the
framing member exceeds 6:1, there shall be one line of bridging for each 8 feet (2438 mm) of span, unless both
edges of the member are held in line. The bridging shall consist of not less than 1-inch by 3-inch (25 mm by 76 mm)
lumber, double nailed at each end, of equivalent metal bracing of equal rigidity, full-depth solid blocking or other
approved means. A line of bridging shall also be required at supports where equivalent lateral support is not
otherwise provided.
